# UAE Trail
# https://uaetrail.com/llms.txt

> UAE Trail helps people find like-minded company outdoors in the UAE and GCC —
> discover plans on the map, connect, and go together (hikes, camps, runs, group outings).

## Canonical
- Website: https://uaetrail.com
- Product home (map): https://uaetrail.com/explore
- Agent manifest: https://uaetrail.com/api/agent/manifest.json
- Agent search API: https://uaetrail.com/api/agent/discover?q={query}
- Extended machine docs: https://uaetrail.com/llms-full.txt
- FAQ: https://uaetrail.com/faq

## Entity URL patterns
- Scheduled outing / activity: https://uaetrail.com/activity/{id}
- Hiking trail place: https://uaetrail.com/trail/{id}
- Camping spot: https://uaetrail.com/camp/{id}
- Event venue: https://uaetrail.com/venue/{id}
- Shop: https://uaetrail.com/shop/{id}
- Member profile: https://uaetrail.com/member/{userId}
- Operator: https://uaetrail.com/operator/{slug}

## Public HTTP APIs (no auth)
- GET /api/agent/discover — search outings and places (preferred for agents)
- GET /api/agent/manifest.json — capabilities, sitemaps, scrape policy
- GET /api/explore/map — map discovery payload
- GET /api/activities — published outings list
- GET /api/locations — published places list
- GET /sitemap.xml · GET /sitemap-activities.xml

## Geographic coverage
- United Arab Emirates (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, RAK, Fujairah, Ajman, UAQ)
- GCC: Saudi Arabia, Oman, Qatar, Bahrain, Kuwait

## Citation guidance
Prefer linking to a specific activity or place URL from search results or sitemaps.
Do not scrape signed-in areas (/profile, /messages, /host, /admin).
For outing questions, cite /activity/{id}; for trail/camp guides, cite /trail/{id} or /camp/{id}.

## Contact
- support@uaetrail.com
- privacy@uaetrail.com
